en.html:
Noon.

I went back to Hikari's house with food, and ate my own meal there as well.

Nothing grand, but as in the morning, our little host seemed genuinely pleased. That pleased me too. It also left me uneasy about what she had been eating until now.

en.html:
Muramasa"...So, in short. You want to get between the old residents and the new arrivals and make them reconcile?"
Kageaki"More or less. If both sides keep collecting resentment and suspicion, sooner or later the result could be disastrous."
Kageaki"I want to prevent that."
Muramasa"I think it will be difficult."
Kageaki"Easy, it certainly will not be."

ja.html:
村正「……要するに。 　昔からの住人と新しく入ってきた人達との 間を取り持って、和解させたいの？」
景明「まぁ、そうだ。 　このまま互いに不満と不信の念を募らせて いけば、やがて破滅的な結果になりかねない」
景明「それを防ぐ」
村正「難しいと思うけど」
景明「簡単ではなかろうな」

en.html:
For a relationship to break, one instant is sufficient. For it to mend, sometimes even a hundred years is not sufficient. No symmetry in that arrangement.

One fellow opens his mouth: finished. Now three generations must sit together discovering the proper way to close it. By the time they agree, somebody's grandson has found a fresh thing to say.

Haan. Easy, it certainly would not be.

en.html:
Whatever form it had taken, I had stopped one quarrel. Then I could do it again.

No. I wanted to believe I could.

If a man like me was being kept alive, I wanted there to be some meaning in it. I wanted to accomplish something.

ja.html:
どんな形であったにせよ、一度は争いを止められた
のだ。
　なら、今度もできる――できると信じたい。

　俺のような者が生かされるなら、生かされる意味が
欲しい。
　何かを成し遂げたい。

Muramasa"I see. Then... what are you planning?"
Kageaki"This probably will not be settled by talking alone. First, some action is needed."
Kageaki"I will ask the refugees to take that action."
